introduce:
Lie on your back in front of a wall with your buttocks close to the wall. Place your legs against the wall and your hands on your abdomen.

As you exhale, bend your legs, open your knees to the sides, and put the soles of your feet together.

Slide your heels down to your groins. Inhale while maintaining loose hips.

Attempt a deeper stretch with each exhalation. Hold this position.
name: WALL BUTTERFLY POSE

tips.text: Please stand in front of a wall.
Please prepare a mat.
Breathe in deeply and breathe out completely.
Make sure your lower back is firmly against the mat and remains relaxed.
You can feel a nice stretch in your groin.

introduce:
Lie on your back with knees bent 90 degrees and feet flat on the wall, hip-width apart. Rest arms by your sides. Lift your hips off the ground.

Open your knees, then bring them together.

Repeat the exercise.
name: WALL BUTT BRIDGE HOLD & HIP ABDUCTION

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Exhale as you open your knees, and inhale as you bring them together.
It helps to stretch your inner thigh muscles.
This is a good exercise for your hip abductors, gluteus maximus and hamstrings.
It also improves your sex life.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your knees bent 90 degrees and feet flat on the wall. Extend your arms to the sides.

Twist your legs to the left while keeping your upper body in place and your knees and feet together.

Hold it for one second, then return and twist to the other side. Repeat the exercise.
name: WALL SUPINE WINDSHIELD WIPERS

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Engage your core.
Breathe steadily throughout.
Avoid rotating your legs to the point where your opposite arm can no longer stay on the floor.
Keep your abs tightened during the entire exercise.
This exercise stretches the lower back.

introduce:
Lie on your back with knees bent 90 degrees and feet flat on the wall, hip-width apart. Rest arms by your sides.

Bring one knee towards your chest, then return to the starting position.

Switch legs and repeat the exercise.
name: WALL LYING BENT LEG RAISES

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Engage your core.
Keep your abs tightened during the entire exercise.
Exhale as you bring one knee towards your chest, and inhale when you return.
This exercise strengthens abs and hip flexors.

introduce:
Lie on your back with knees bent 90 degrees and feet flat on the wall, hip-width apart. Rest arms by your sides.

Lift your upper body off the ground with arms extended parallel to the ground.

Come back down and repeat the exercise.
name: WALL ABDOMINAL CRUNCHES

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Focus on using your abdominal muscles.
Keep your neck in a neutral position by avoiding any forward tilting.
Keep your chin slightly tucked towards your chest.
Avoid using your arms to propel your body upwards.
Always keep your lower back on the floor.
Exhale when lifting, and inhale when lowering.
It's a good exercise for your abs.

introduce:
Lie on your back with knees bent 90 degrees and feet flat on the wall, hip-width apart. Lift your upper body off the ground with arms extended parallel to the ground.

Inhale through your nose for a count of 5, then exhale through your mouth for a count of 5 while simultaneously pumping your arms up and down.

Repeat the exercise.
name: WALL THE HUNDRED

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Focus on using your abdominal muscles.
Please control your breathing and your movements.
Avoid straining your neck and head.
This exercise primarily targets abdominal stability and strength.

introduce:
Lie on the floor with your hands behind your ears. Raise your legs and place your feet against the wall.

Raise your knees and close your right elbow toward your left knee, then close your left elbow toward your right knee.

Repeat the exercise.
name: WALL BICYCLE CRUNCHES

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Tighten your abs.
Keep a neutral neck position and avoid excessive forward-leaning.
Lift your shoulders off the ground while rotating the spine with control.
This exercise works on your transverse abs and internal and external obliques.

introduce:
Sit facing a wall with your legs bent and toes touching where the wall meets the floor. Lean back slightly, supporting yourself with both hands on the floor.

Engage your abs to lift your upper body towards the ceiling, then slightly round your back.

Repeat it.
name: WALL ABDOMINAL ROLL BACK AND FORTH

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Focus on using your abdominal muscles to lift your upper body.
Avoid relying solely on your arms for support.
You should feel your abs pulling in.
Inhale as you lift your upper body, and exhale as you round your back.
It primarily strengthens the abs.

introduce:
Sit facing a wall with your legs bent and toes touching where the wall meets the floor. Lean back slightly, supporting yourself with both hands on the floor.

Lift one foot, bringing your toes to tap the wall. Return and lift the other foot to tap the wall.

Repeat it.
name: WALL TOE TAP

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Keep your core engaged and your back straight.
Keep your neck relaxed and in a neutral position.
Exhale as you tap your foot, and inhale as you return it to the starting position.
This exercise works on your abs.

introduce:
Lie on your back with knees bent 90 degrees and feet flat on the wall, hip-width apart. Rest arms by your sides.

Lift your hips off the floor, forming a straight line from your waist to your knees.

Lower your hips back down to the floor and repeat.
name: WALL BUTT BRIDGE

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Engage your glutes to lift your hips.
Keep your waist, hips, and knees aligned.
Focus on lowering your hips back down to touch the floor.
Exhale when lifting your hips, and inhale when lowering them.
This exercise works on your glutes, abs and hamstrings.

introduce:
Sit on the floor with your feet against the wall. Lower your back to the floor while supporting yourself with your arms.

Engage your abs to lift your legs up towards the ceiling until they are parallel to the wall.

Slowly bring your legs back down and repeat the exercise.
name: WALL LEG RAISE

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Raise your legs faster and put them down slower.
Keep your legs as straight as possible.
You shouldn't feel any pressure in your chest and shoulder area.
Exhale when lifting your legs, and inhale when lowering them.
This exercise targets your lower abs.
